WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
),
filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_id, i_current_price
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
)
SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - NULLIF(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - NULLIF(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales
JOIN date_range ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cr_order_number = cs_order_number AND cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN filtered_item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
WHERE cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
